scope: Complete optional-module primary-surface ON/OFF matrix; all 25 optional keys and callable registry guard.

assertions.chat: Real destination validation, encrypted persistence and scoped audit; deterministic public DNS response, no delivery.
assertions.email: Real dispatch through local-memory transport, SENT log, recipient/body and scoped audit; no SMTP delivery.
assertions.payments: Real settings GET/PATCH/readback and module refusal; no payment or provider onboarding created.
assertions.member_accounts: Real anonymous phone-start gate with explicit platform phone switch; downstream OTP/account lookup/delivery boundary controlled.
assertions.mobile: Real challenge, attested login, password, grant, family and signed token bindings; provider attestation HTTP controlled; OFF creates no grants/tokens.

coverage_limits: One primary API surface per module; this record does not certify every endpoint or live external provider.
No fresh monolithic complete backend-suite claim.
